audience: tutoring and lesson businesses that manage students, lessons and invoices in Teachworks

useCases.title: See the lesson calendar and who teaches
useCases.text: The AI lists lessons with teacher, service, location, time, status and participants, filtered by teacher, student, location or date range. It can check teacher availability slots too.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and sum what is outstanding
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by customer, status or due date range with totals, and opens one with its line items. It adds up what is still outstanding.

useCases.title: Count lessons and tutor earnings for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads lesson totals for a student, customer or employee, and the earnings of a tutor for a date range and lesson status. You can prepare tutor pay.

useCases.title: Look up students, families and payments
useCases.text: The AI finds students and customers (families) with their contact details, and lists their payments with method, refunds and invoice allocations.

useCases.title: Add a family or student and book a lesson
useCases.text: The AI creates a family and child students, schedules a lesson with a teacher, service and location, and adds a student to a scheduled lesson. Check availability and lessons first to avoid conflicts.

useCases.title: Record a payment received from a customer
useCases.text: The AI records a payment from a customer as bookkeeping only. It does not charge a card. You can check the customer's invoices first.
